QuestInfo.0: Talk to Cassandra if you lost your Honey Butterfly Journal.
QuestInfo.1: Talk to Cassandra if you lost your Honey Butterfly Journal.
QuestInfo.2: How did you lose your Honey Butterfly Journal? Things like this are important!

1.msg: I knew it! It's cool. This Honey Butterfly Journal is high-tech and hooked up to a state-of-the-art cloud system that syncs up automatically!\r\nAll you need is another #b#t4320003##k. Want one?

0.0: Liar! You don't have the #t4320003#! I was gonna give another one to you if you came clean. But NOPE!
0.1: You...threw it away? Purposely? I can't believe you'd throw away a chance to get buffs and a medal... I'm so shocked, I don't think I can give this to you. Yes, intentionally.

no.0: I mean, if you really don't think you need one... But remember, you need this #t4320003# to decorate and play with your Honey Butterfly. And there's a sweet medal waiting for you if you get close to your butterfly... Isn't that appealing?\r\n#bJust talk to me if you want this #t4320003##k.

yes.0: I'm still kind of sad that you lost the first #t4320003#, but I'll be nice and give you another chance. Check your Etc inventory.

default.0: Hm, something's strange. I can't give you another #t4320003#.
